title: Natural-Language-to-Complete-System Compiler — Overview and definition

Converts a detailed request into a multi-component software project with tests and deployment instructions. A proposed compiler that takes a detailed natural-language request and produces a complete multi-component software project: source code, data schemas, tests, build scripts, and deployment instructions. The user describes what the system must do and its constraints; the compiler designs the architecture, generates the components, writes tests that verify the stated requirements, and documents how to deploy it.
